findings.title: payments runs a privileged container
findings.verification_evidence: Pod payments-6f7c-abcde container "app" has securityContext {"privileged":true}, and it also mounts hostPath /var/run/docker.sock.

findings.title: payments mounts the docker socket
findings.verification_evidence: get_manifest for Deployment shop/payments returned {"found":false}, so I couldn't check for a docker socket hostPath mount.

findings.title: web container may run as root
findings.verification_evidence: Pod web-5d8b-xyz12 container "web" has securityContext runAsNonRoot:true, runAsUser:1000, allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, so it is not configured to run as root.

findings.title: worker uses a hostPath volume
findings.verification_evidence: Pod worker-77c9-qwert has only one volume, "scratch", with type emptyDir and hostPath null, so it has no hostPath volume.

findings.title: node-agent DaemonSet uses host networking
findings.verification_evidence: The security context for the monitoring/node-agent DaemonSet template shows "hostNetwork":true. hostPID and hostIPC are both false.

findings.title: web has no CPU or memory limits
findings.verification_evidence: get_manifest for Deployment shop/web returned {"found":false}, so I couldn't check its resource limits.
